title: Back up your setup and move to a new PC
description: Export your configuration — document types, filing scheme, templates and everything learned — to one password-encrypted file, and restore it on a new machine. Settings -> Advanced -> Backup & Restore. NOTE: both Export Backup (a Save dialog) and Restore Backup (an Open dialog) are NATIVE Windows dialogs and are NOT filmed — those buttons are only hovered and narrated. NEEDS OWNER: do the actual Export/Restore file choice off-camera.

steps.narration: Everything you set up — your document types, your filing scheme, and everything ScanFinder has learned — can be saved to one encrypted file, and restored on a new PC in minutes.
steps.caption: Back up and move PCs

steps.narration: Open Settings from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Open Settings

steps.narration: Under Backup and Restore, choose a password. It's what locks the file — without it, nobody can open your backup, so keep it safe.
steps.caption: 3. Choose a backup password

steps.narration: and type it again to confirm.
steps.caption: Confirm it

steps.narration: Then Export Backup — a Save dialog opens, and you choose where to keep the file, like a USB stick.
steps.caption: 4. Export Backup

steps.narration: On your new PC, install ScanFinder, come to this same tab, type the password, and click Restore Backup to bring back every type, template and learned value.
steps.caption: 5. Restore on the new PC

steps.narration: One file carries your whole setup across. Your documents move separately — they're just ordinary files in your output folder.
steps.caption: Your setup travels in one file
